title: Grok Skill Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter schema for .grok/skills/*/SKILL.md (and synced copies). Follows the agentskills.io spec used by Grok Build.

name.description: Name of the skill. Must match the directory name (kebab-case).

description.description: Short description of what the skill does and when to use it. Shown in the system prompt.

argument-hint.description: Example arguments or usage hint shown to the user.

user-invocable.description: Whether the skill can be directly invoked by the user with /name.

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, the model cannot decide to call this skill on its own.

allowed-tools.description: Explicit list of tools this skill is allowed to use. Principle of least privilege. See docs/reference/tools.md

compatibility.description: Optional compatibility notes or version info.

metadata.description: Free-form additional metadata. Put custom fields here.
